criteria.legacy: One of the 232 US directory entries offered before this list (23 November 2026), kept until there is a reason to remove it. It becomes verified on its first find.
criteria.verified: All four: identity (name, state and catalog host from a published source); permission (the robots.txt result for the app's own token, else *, with its date; the catalog's terms read and its storage decision in server/data/catalog-policies.json, live-only while unread; no wall seen); scope (whether the check is limited to the member or answers from a shared catalog, recorded on the entry); and a find by the app's own check (run with the app's tooling where the host allows agents and storage, otherwise a tap through the live app seen in the outcome counts).
criteria.connected: A new entry of a connected catalog family (TLC from 24 November 2026, USA plan step 3; Koha at ByWater from 24 November 2026, step 4; Aspen Discovery from 24 November 2026, step 5; Polaris PowerPAC from 24 November 2026, step 6; Apollo (Biblionix) from 24 November 2026, step 7, added from a checked list of hosts by tools/directory/apollo-hosts.mjs; Evergreen (the Georgia PINES member systems) from 24 November 2026, step 8, made from PINES's org tree and the IMLS records by tools/directory/pines-systems.mjs): identity (name, state and town from the IMLS Public Libraries Survey with its FSCSKEY; the catalog host from a published page: the library's own site, a state directory or the catalog's own page naming the library, or a host on the library's own domain; or a DNS lead whose subdomain plainly names the library, or the shared catalog it is a member of, on the vendor's hosting domain, coordinator decision of 24 November 2026); permission (robots.txt for the app's own token, else *, read live before every check; the storage decision in server/data/catalog-policies.json, live-only while unread; no wall seen, or none looked for where agents may not look, and a wall is couldn't check); scope (catalogScope on the entry: the library's own catalog, or a shared catalog whose find counts for the member); offered once the family's adapter passes its fixture tests (US build brief, 23 November 2026), and, where its catalog host is in server/data/front-page-hosts.json (it allows every agent but blocks AI agents, or disallows only capital-P Polaris paths, so no agent could look for a wall; or no agent was cleared to look; or a wall was seen only by a research agent), only once server/data/front-page-results.json records the host open: wall none, robots.txt allowing the app, not moved to another host, and a 2xx front page (services/directory.js; until then its listing is front-page). It becomes verified on its first find through the live app.
criteria.waiting: In the directory and resolvable by ID, but not offered: the entry waits on what its reason names (identity: a catalog host known only from a DNS lead whose name fits more than one library or does not plainly name it, a member list that is an estimate or general knowledge, or a family not confirmed). It is moved to libraryIds and connected once that is settled.

rules: Kept by hand. A new US directory entry is offered only once it is added to libraryIds and either verified (it meets every verified criterion) or connected (an entry of a connected catalog family meeting the connected criteria, which becomes verified on its first find through the live app).

A connected entry whose catalog host is in server/data/front-page-hosts.json is offered automatically once server/data/front-page-results.json records that host open; nothing here changes. Any other result keeps it unoffered: a wall (challenge, 403, 429) or robots.txt disallowing the app means it is moved to removed with the reason; a host that was unreachable, moved to another host or answered without a 2xx page is asked again by removing its result, or its entry's host is corrected.

A listed library stays listed when a later check fails or cannot reach it; failed checks are logged for manual review. A library whose catalog blocks the app (robots.txt, a wall, a 403 for the app's user agent) is moved to removed, never kept for having been listed before.
To remove a library, add { id, reason, date } to removed and take it out of libraryIds, verified and connected. The removed list wins over any later find; delete the entry to list it again.

places corrects or fills a US entry's state, town and position from published evidence only (the IMLS Public Libraries Survey, the library's own website or the catalog's own branch list), never from a library's name. Each records its evidence; replaces names the wrong values it corrects.
waiting lists directory entries that are not offered yet, each with { id, waitsOn, reason, date }; an ID is in libraryIds or waiting, never both.
